_how: The Bookkeeper's settings. Re-read every time a life begins (no restart). The personality itself is bookkeeper.md. Key: openai.key next to this file (one line; git ignores it; push.sh sends it), or OPENAI_API_KEY.
_model: gpt-realtime-2.1 = the best character. gpt-realtime-2.1-mini = faster and about a third of the cost; try it if lines arrive late.
_voice: try cedar and marin by ear
_reasoning: minimal | low | medium, or off to leave it out. Higher = better lines, later lines.
_accent: empty = neutral. To try: "Speak English with a light Indian accent. Keep it steady from the first word to the last, don't exaggerate it, and keep it easy to understand."
_predict_player: false = opinions on the cards only. true = it also calls which card the player will pick (bookkeeper.md, the part between the predict markers).
_show_text: false = the voice carries the words, no narrative box. true = the boxes stay up as well (subtitles). Without a voice (no key, no connection) the boxes always come back.
_player_can_talk: false = it never answers the player, it only speaks at the game's moments
_max_wait_s: the longest the game waits for a line to finish before it carries on
_mic: near_field for a laptop mic, far_field for a room mic in the installation
_listen_eagerness: low lets people pause and think before it answers; high answers sooner
